chunks: Ayyub ibn Nuh narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, who said: I heard Ali ibn Ja'far saying:

I was with my brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), who by Allah was the Divine Proof on the earth after my father (peace be upon him and his family). Just then his son Ali arrived, and he said to me: 'O Ali, this is your master, and his position with me is like my position with my father. May Allah keep you firm on His religion.' I wept and said to myself: 'He is conveying the news of his death to me.' He said: 'O Ali, it is inevitable that divine destiny be issued regarding me, and I have as a model the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the Commander of the Faithful, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husain (peace be upon them). This occurred three days before Harun al-Rashid took him away for the second time. The report is complete. The narrations on this theme are too numerous to count, and they exist in the books of the Imamiyyah, known and famous. Whoever wishes may refer to them from there, and what is mentioned here is sufficient, if Allah wills.'
ai.seo_question: What did Musa ibn al-Kadhim say about his son Ali before his death?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this pivotal declaration by Imam Musa al-Kadhim, affirming Ali ibn al-Husayn (al-Rida) as the 'Hujjah of God' and successor, explicitly linking his authority to the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt. This event, occurring just three days before the Imam's second imprisonment by Harun al-Rashid, serves as a critical prelude to the consolidation of Imamate authority in the Ja'fari lineage, underscoring the divine designation (Nass) that Shia scholars regard as essential for legitimate leadership.
